title: PREREG_HYB (iteration 3, T3): rename-invariant cross-family consensus PEER_HYB
git_note: workspace is not a git repository; integrity = sha256 of this file (prereg_hyb.sha256)

pair_definitions.align_eq: vendor_c common.eqmv(parse(peer), parse(cand)) -- exactly exp 5 pool_scoring.score_sentence's c_score_align call; 30 s SIGALRM cap -> None (UNKNOWN)
pair_definitions.nf_eq: peer_text.pair_result(cand, peer, ent, text, variant='NF-anchored', k=5, tau=0.5)['equiv'] (exp 5 frozen params; timeout_ms 2000, unit_cap 16)
pair_definitions.hyb_eq: True if align_eq is True or nf_eq is True; False if both False; else None (UNKNOWN, never counts as agreement)

scores.c_score_m: 1 - #(peers with m_eq True)/#peers used, m in {align, nf, hyb}; leave-one-FAMILY-out with exp 5 vendor family map; NA if < 2 peers (peer_unavailable); PERTURB rows use every peer (base is a reference with no family)
scores.c_nf_headline: frozen exp 5 nf_c_score (graded_consensus c_score_nf under NF-anchored); c_align headline = frozen c_score_align
scores.g_score_hyb: graded_consensus over the composite pair table: ALIGN record if align_eq True, else NF record if nf_eq True, else the record with more verified unit entailments (fwd+bwd), ties -> ALIGN. All other internals unchanged.

variant_score_for_selection.NF-anchored: c_nf (frozen nf_c_score on E; re-derived c_nf on screen/PERTURB)

scores.coverage: UNPARSEABLE candidates score 1.0 in the coverage view and are excluded (counted) in the parseable view; E AUROCs use exp 5's imputation rule (unparseable -> 1.0)

threshold_rule.rule: per variant, matched-FA threshold at FA = 0.10 on screen track-L (LLM) CORRECT items of the exp 5 AGREE set (solver label == adjudicated label) WITH FRACTIONAL tie-breaking: at the tie level t flag rows with score > t fully and rows with score == t with weight q such that FA is exactly 0.10; FA/recall reported as tie-aware expected rates; no random draw
threshold_rule.degenerate: if > 50% of CORRECT tie at the max, report threshold-free AUROC + tie share and mark recall rows 'threshold-degenerate'

rename_fa_definition.definition: share (tie-aware expectation) of rename-rewritten CORRECT bases flagged at the frozen screen threshold, computed SEPARATELY on (i) exp D RENAME rewrites of screen CORRECT bases (RW:*_RENAME*), (ii) PERTURB RENAME_SYN controls, (iii) PERTURB RENAME_NONCE controls (E-base pools; PERTURB controls are CORRECT by construction)
rename_fa_definition.flip_rate: reported in its own column (rewrite flagged XOR its base flagged, over bases), never enters the rule
rename_fa_definition.note: PERTURB rename controls are CORRECT by construction and are scored against real LLM peers of their E sentence; the base reference itself must be endorsed for rename FA to be meaningful, so FA is ALSO reported restricted to endorsed bases (secondary)

selection_rule_verbatim: Among {HYB, NF-anchored}, a variant is eligible iff RENAME FA <= 0.10 on (i), (ii) and (iii). Among eligible variants, FREEZE the one with the higher E stratified AUROC under R_AB. Tie (|diff| < 0.005) -> NF-anchored (single-map variant with fewer agreements, less over-alignment risk). If neither is eligible: no rename-invariant consensus exists here; report both as failed and state that the R_COMP read uses ALIGN. R_COMP never takes part.

E_regimes.R_AB: system_class llm, label_tier in {A,B}, final_label in {CORRECT, ERROR}, not reading_choice, CONTESTED excluded
E_regimes.R_A: R_AB with label_tier A; primary R_A read on L20+EXC

stratified_auroc: sum over strata (CTRL, EXC, L20, L25) of AUROC_s * n1_s * n0_s / sum n1_s * n0_s (exp 5 strat_auc)

bootstrap.cluster: sentence_id on E and screen; base_item_id on PERTURB

testability: >= 50 ERROR and >= 50 CORRECT rows per cell, else 'untestable' (point estimates only); PERTURB operator cells < 30 rows -> untestable

targets.HYB_minus_ALIGN_E_stratified_AUROC: within 0.01 (i.e. delta >= -0.01) = HYB keeps ALIGN's discrimination

over_alignment_checks: PERTURB MEANING_RENAME (DOWN/UP) and SWAP recall at the frozen threshold
screen probes MEANING_RENAME / ROLE_PERMUTE / SWAP recall
E new-agreement audit: pairs with hyb_eq True and align_eq not True -> label-discordance rate vs ALIGN-agreeing pairs
no_post_hoc_in_headline: no weighted OR / other tau / other k enters the headline; any exploration is labelled post hoc in deviations.json
